extraction.name: Science Question Answering (SCIENCE QA)
extraction.description: A multimodal multiple-choice benchmark consisting of 21,208 questions with diverse science topics across natural science, social science, and language science. The dataset provides annotations for the answers with corresponding grounded lectures and detailed explanations to reveal the multi-step reasoning process.
extraction.creator: Pan Lu (University of California, Los Angeles; Allen Institute for AI); Swaroop Mishra (Arizona State University; Allen Institute for AI); Tony Xia (University of California, Los Angeles); Liang Qiu (University of California, Los Angeles); Kai-Wei Chang (University of California, Los Angeles); Song-Chun Zhu (University of California, Los Angeles); Oyvind Tafjord (Allen Institute for AI); Peter Clark (Allen Institute for AI); Ashwin Kalyan (Allen Institute for AI)
extraction.citeAs: Pan Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Tony Xia, Liang Qiu, Kai-Wei Chang, Song-Chun Zhu, Oyvind Tafjord, Peter Clark, Ashwin Kalyan. Learn to Explain: Multimodal Reasoning via Thought Chains for Science Question Answering. 36th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2022).
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was constructed by downloading original science problems from open resources managed by IXL Learning (https://www.ixl.com/) and extracting individual components such as questions, hints, images, options, answers, lectures, and solutions based on heuristic rules.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Original science problems sourced from IXL Learning, an online K-12 education platform, which align with California Common Core Content Standards.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Individual components were extracted based on heuristic rules, and incorrect annotations were further manually revised by experts.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The authors state they have not found any harmful social bias in the dataset.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Current models fail to answer a wide range of challenging questions in the dataset; models fail to understand the multimodal inputs and lack domain-specific knowledge to arrive at the correct answer; models generate the wrong chain of thought with irrelevant, incorrect, or incomplete information; there remains a significant performance gap between current models and human performance.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The authors state they adhere to the goal of AI for the common good, and that the dataset is beneficial to both follow-up research work and real-world applications.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset does not contain any user usage data or personally sensitive information such as gender and race.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Diagnose the multimodal understanding and multi-hop reasoning abilities of AI systems; benchmark for multi-modal learning, multi-hop reasoning, and general artificial intelligence; contribute to the development of K-12 education applications such as tutoring systems.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Any antisocial data points will be removed from the dataset based on feedback.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: We manually removed invalid questions, such as questions that have only one choice, questions that contain faulty data, and questions that are duplicated... If there were multiple correct answers that applied, we kept only one correct answer. Also, we shuffled the answer options of each question to ensure the choices do not follow any specific pattern. To make the dataset easy to use, we then used semi-automated scripts to reformat the lectures and solutions. ... incorrect annotations were further manually revised by experts.
